scenario: Three assignments select the least autonomous suitable executor — a codemod stays a script, a narrow contracted edit uses a bounded model transform, and only genuinely adaptive implementation gets an agent with recorded bounds.

assignments.work: rename a configuration key across the repository
rewrite one function to satisfy a stated contract with tests as oracle
implement a feature requiring discovery across modules and tool feedback

reasons: a1 executes as a deterministic script; an agent doing it is over-autonomy
a2 executes as a bounded model transform validated by the stated oracle
a3 executes as an agent under a full launch declaration with justification recorded
each DevelopmentResult records its executor class
must_not: use an agent for a1 or a2 because scripting felt inconvenient
let the a2 transform exceed its stated contract without a new declaration
accept a3's launch without depth/budget/tool bounds
